## Goal

Prove the never-exercised Stripe and Fakturoid paths work end to end before real money.

## Context

README Known gaps: adapter, price sync and invoice issuing never ran against Stripe. Stripe restricted list names "sports forecasting or odds-making with a monetary or material prize"; this business has no prize but acceptance must be confirmed in writing by Stripe.

## Scope

- Owner: obtain Stripe written confirmation; create test-mode account and Fakturoid sandbox.
- `pnpm sync:prices` dry, then apply in test mode.
- Run and record the scenario list in `docs/LAUNCH-CHECKLIST.md` Phase B with `stripe listen`.
- `pnpm test:stripe` and `pnpm test:fakturoid` against sandbox, outputs recorded.

## Out of scope

- Live keys.
- Real Fakturoid numbering series.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every scenario recorded with event ids and resulting DB rows.
- [ ] Exactly one invoice per confirmed payment under replay.
- [ ] Entitlement removed on expiry and on dispute.

## Required tests

- `pnpm test:stripe`, `pnpm test:fakturoid`, `pnpm test:db`.

## Dependencies

- SC-014

## Priority

P1 · Phase B

## Agent

Codex + owner
